scope.description: Required with items: "first_task", "continuation" or "new_task" (see the tool description). Omit on advance / done / start updates.

session.description: When you delegated this step to a session you started: that session's short name (from start_session's result). The app shows its live state on the step.

items.description: The whole plan, in order (1–12 steps); replaces the previous list.

tools.name: mcp__ccd_turn__wrap_up
tools.description:
Fill the "next step" box the app shows at the end of your turn: a two-or-three-sentence recap and, when this turn leaves the user a decision to make or a step to take, one question and buttons that answer it; a turn with nothing pending ends with the recap alone, and the app then draws no box. Call it once in EVERY turn in which you kept a task list, changed files, ran commands, or completed multi-step work: when this turn's work is done, before any closing message (it also checks off the task list; no closing update_plan is needed). Skip it for short answers, pure conversation, or a brief read-and-explain turn — a reply that names a follow-up is not brief: ask or propose it, and call this.

Your closing message is ordinary text right after this call, the last thing you say this turn: your answer to the user in full, which the recap never replaces. Never write it before this call, where it can reach the user cut to a short summary. The result says whether the box shows your question: ask in the message only a question it does not show.

Fields — recap and ask are said to the user, in the second person; a reply button's label and message are the user's words back to you:
- recap: what is now true or changed, then where it stands, including what is not done or not verified (for example: nothing committed, or not checked in the app). Two or three short sentences, about 40 words / 300 characters, in the project's own words. No recommendation here.
- ask (with actions, only when the next move is the user's call — a choice of approach, a go-ahead to fix, commit, push, post or send, an approval): just that ONE decision in one short sentence, never two joined by "and" ("Which fix first?"), with no reason or recommendation and without listing the options the buttons give: your pick, actions[0], is drawn as the primary button. At most 100 characters.
Every field is a top-level parameter holding plain prose (actions: a JSON array); none contains markup or another field.

recap.description: Two or three short sentences to the user (≤300 chars): what is now true or changed, then where it stands, including what is not done or not verified. Its first sentence is the sidebar status. It must stand on its own, since it is also read away from the transcript and the box draws under anything you write after this call: never point at anything else in the conversation ("listed below", "see above", "in my message").

ask.description: The one question (≤100 chars) when the next move is the user's call — a choice, a go-ahead (to act here on what this turn found, say), an approval: the decision alone, with no reason or recommendation and without listing the options the buttons give (actions[0] is your pick). Like the recap, never point at anything else in the conversation. Omit it, and actions, when nothing waits on the user.

blocked.description: true when your work stops here until the user answers (the app marks the session as waiting on them); omit when the answer can wait.

action.description: An app action update_plan's result listed as available now, or one your own work this turn made available; anything else is refused, and one that stops being available later is dropped (as actions[0], with your ask and the other answers), so do not guess. Omit for a reply.

label.description: For a reply: the button text, 1–3 words (4 only when three cannot say it) / 24 characters — "Yes, fix 1", "Fix 2 instead", "Not now": a button, not a sentence; the detail goes in message. No leading / or !. Ignored for an app action (the app's own label is used).

message.description: For a reply: what the click sends, up to 300 characters of plain text — no leading / or !. Omit when the label is the whole message.

actions.description: 1–2 buttons, recommendation first. They are answers to your ask: the first accepts your recommendation, and another is there only when it is a realistic alternative the user might pick instead — not a menu of everything you mentioned. When blocked is true, they are the most likely answers to your question. While Auto-fix is on for the session's PR, none offers to watch it, fix CI, resolve conflicts or address comments.

tools.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__browser_batch
tools.description: Execute a sequence of Browser pane tool calls in ONE round trip. Each item is {name, input} where input is exactly what you'd pass to that tool standalone. Actions execute SEQUENTIALLY (not in parallel) and stop on the first error. Use this tool extensively to quickly execute work whenever you can predict two or more steps ahead — e.g. navigate, click a field, type, press Return, screenshot. Each tool's own permission check runs per item — a step on a site the user hasn't allowed either asks the user inline (and continues if they allow) or is refused, which stops the batch; if a step is refused for a missing permission, call that tool on its own (that call can ask the user), then batch the rest. Screenshots and other images are returned interleaved with outputs; coordinates you write in THIS batch refer to the screenshot taken BEFORE this call. browser_batch cannot be nested, and preview_start is not batchable — but if the Browser pane isn't open yet, a batch whose FIRST action is navigate with a url opens it (other actions still need an open page).

input.description: That tool's input — same shape you'd pass when calling it directly. For computer items whose action is left_click, right_click, double_click, triple_click, left_click_drag, key or type, and for form_input items, include action_summary in the item's input, as you would when calling that tool directly.

tools.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__computer
tools.description: Mouse/keyboard automation in the Browser pane. Clicks accept either `coordinate` (pixels in the coordinate frame of the most recent `computer{action:"screenshot"}` — reported with every scaled screenshot; equal to the image's pixels for unscaled ones) or `ref` (a `ref_N` from read_page/find). Whenever you intend to click on an element like an icon, you should consult a screenshot to determine the coordinates of the element first; after the tab loads a different site, take a new screenshot before clicking by `coordinate`.

schema.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__computer
schema.description: Mouse/keyboard automation in the Browser pane. Clicks accept either `coordinate` (pixels in the coordinate frame of the most recent `computer{action:"screenshot"}` — reported with every scaled screenshot; equal to the image's pixels for unscaled ones) or `ref` (a `ref_N` from read_page/find). Whenever you intend to click on an element like an icon, you should consult a screenshot to determine the coordinates of the element first; after the tab loads a different site, take a new screenshot before clicking by `coordinate`.

tabId.description: Tab to act on within the preview context. Omit for the fronted tab; get ids from tabs_context.

action.description:
The action to perform:
* `left_click`: Click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `right_click`: Click the right mouse button at the specified coordinates to open context menus.
* `double_click`: Double-click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `triple_click`: Triple-click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `type`: Type a string of text.
* `screenshot`: Take a screenshot of the screen.
* `wait`: Wait for a specified number of seconds.
* `scroll`: Scroll up, down, left, or right at the specified coordinates.
* `key`: Press a specific keyboard key.
* `left_click_drag`: Drag from start_coordinate to coordinate.
* `zoom`: Take a screenshot of a specific region for closer inspection.
* `scroll_to`: Scroll an element into view using its element reference ID from read_page or find tools.
* `hover`: Move the mouse cursor to the specified coordinates or element without clicking. Useful for revealing tooltips, dropdown menus, or triggering hover states.

coordinate.description: (x, y): The x (pixels from the left edge) and y (pixels from the top edge) coordinates. Required for `left_click`, `right_click`, `double_click`, `triple_click`, and `scroll`. For `left_click_drag`, this is the end position.

text.description: The text to type (for `type` action) or the key(s) to press (for `key` action). For `key` action: Provide space-separated keys (e.g., "Backspace Backspace Delete"). Supports keyboard shortcuts using the platform's modifier key (use "cmd" on Mac, "ctrl" on Windows/Linux, e.g., "cmd+a" or "ctrl+a" for select all). Page zoom shortcuts (e.g. "cmd+=", "ctrl+-", "cmd+0") are not supported - use the `zoom` action to magnify a region of the page instead.

duration.description: The number of seconds to wait. Required for `wait`. Maximum 10 seconds.

scroll_direction.description: The direction to scroll. Required for `scroll`.

scroll_amount.description: The number of scroll wheel ticks. Optional for `scroll`, defaults to 3.

region.description: (x0, y0, x1, y1): The rectangular region to capture for `zoom`. Coordinates define a rectangle from top-left (x0, y0) to bottom-right (x1, y1) in pixels from the viewport origin. Required for `zoom` action. Useful for inspecting small UI elements like icons, buttons, or text.

scale.description: For `screenshot` and `zoom` only. Scale factor in [0.1, 1] for the returned image; 1 (default) uses the full image token budget, 0.5 returns an image at half the width and height (~quarter of the tokens). Coordinates are ALWAYS in the full-resolution coordinate frame (reported with every scaled screenshot), never in the scaled image's own pixels.

repeat.description: Number of times to repeat the key sequence. Only applicable for `key` action. Must be a positive integer between 1 and 100. Default is 1. Useful for navigation tasks like pressing arrow keys multiple times.

ref.description: Element reference ID from read_page or find tools (e.g., "ref_1", "ref_2"). Required for `scroll_to` action. Can be used as alternative to `coordinate` for click actions.

modifiers.description: Modifier keys for click actions. Supports: "ctrl", "shift", "alt", "cmd" (or "meta"), "win" (or "windows"). Can be combined with "+" (e.g., "ctrl+shift", "cmd+alt"). Optional.

action_summary.description: A few words saying what this action does on the page and to what, for example 'Sends the drafted reply to pat@example.com' or 'Opens the Filters menu'. Set it on every left_click, right_click, double_click, triple_click, left_click_drag, key and type action. State the effect only, and accurately: no reasons, nothing about what you were asked or allowed to do, no passwords or other secrets.

tools.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__resize_window
tools.description: Emulate a viewport size in the Browser pane tab. Presets: mobile (375x812), tablet (768x1024), or desktop, which clears the size emulation and returns the tab to the pane's own responsive size. Custom sizes need both width and height. An emulated size applies to that tab across reloads and navigation (scaled down to fit when it is larger than the pane): reset it with preset "desktop" as soon as you finish testing. action.description: What to do. 'attach' opens the live simulator panel for the user — call it BEFORE you build or launch, as soon as the user wants to see the app: on a booted simulator it opens immediately, and otherwise it returns a clear, harmless error (boot or build first, then retry it). Do not skip the early attach because 'launch' also attaches — the panel should be open before the build starts. The panel is the user's view, not a precondition — 'screenshot' and input actions work without it. Skip it only when the user has no interest in watching; 'launch' installs and launches an .app (it also re-attaches, but call 'attach' early rather than relying on that); 'screenshot' returns a PNG of the current screen; 'tap'/'swipe'/'text'/'button' inject input; 'press_key' presses a hardware key 'count' times: return, delete (backspace), an arrow, select_all, undo or redo (a key also hides the on-screen keyboard); 'set_appearance' switches the device to light or dark mode; 'appearance' says which it is in; 'set_keyboard' shows or hides the on-screen keyboard (it appears only while a text field has focus, and 'press_key' and 'text' hide it again); 'rotate' turns the device a quarter turn left or right ('direction'); take a 'screenshot' after it and tap in that screenshot's frame, however it comes back; 'touch_path' performs a single-finger drag along an arbitrary path (eased curves, long-press-then-drag); 'touch2_path' is the two-finger variant for pinch/rotate; 'open_url' opens a deep link; 'detach' closes the panel/stream. NOTE: a 'swipe' or 'touch_path' whose start point is on-screen and within 4pt of an edge performs the OS edge gesture instead of a plain drag — left=back, top=notification shade, bottom=home/app-switcher, right=Control Center (mapped to the current interface orientation). Start more than 4pt from the edge to drag or scroll content near the bezel.

points.description: For 'touch_path': touch path samples in device points. First point is touch-down; last is touch-up. dt_ms is the delay before that sample (0-1000 ms; the first sample's is skipped, so send 0 or omit it; at most 30 seconds in all).

points2.description: For 'touch2_path': two-finger path samples in device points. Each sample carries both contacts (x1/y1, x2/y2); first is touch-down, last is touch-up. dt_ms is the delay before that sample (0-1000 ms; the first sample's is skipped, so send 0 or omit it; at most 30 seconds in all).

key.description: For 'press_key': the key or edit command to press.

# MM-03.3 v0.2, jalon 1, passe 8 : forme des destinations, initialisation par les seules écritures, bilan de clôture (rapport d'exploration v0.1, passe 8)

Branche `formal/access_model_0.1`, à la suite de la passe 7 (dernier commit de passe 7 : `d01fc23`). Module `formal/Ern/MM03.lean`, espace de noms `Ern.MM03`. `formal/Ern/MM02.lean` est inchangé : `git diff d01fc23 -- formal/Ern/MM02.lean` est vide.

Sources :
- MM-03.3 v0.2 (`ERN_Memory_Model_0.3.3.md`, hors dépôt) ;
- les arbitrages A1 à A11, B1 à B10, C1 à C9, D1 à D4, F1 à F7 et G1 à G5, en vigueur sauf ce que J1 remplace ;
- les arbitrages J1 et J2 de cette tâche, qui font foi.

Le rapport de passe 7 est `formal/reports/MM03_v0.1_p7.md`. Ses décisions et questions sont citées sous la forme « passe 7, (c) n ».

## État de la vérification

| Contrôle | Résultat |
|---|---|
| `lake build` | réussit, sans avertissement |
| `sorry`, `admit`, `axiom`, `native_decide`, `noncomputable` | aucun dans `formal/` |
| `#print axioms` sur les 605 théorèmes | au plus `propext` et `Quot.sound` : 492 utilisent les deux, 104 `propext` seul, 9 aucun ; `Classical.choice` n'apparaît nulle part |
| `example` | 358, tous vérifiés par le build : sur les 364 de la passe 7, 342 inchangés et 22 retirés ; 16 ajoutés ((p)) |

## Résultats principaux

1. **Forme des destinations de `transfer` (J1).**
   - `TransferPre` reçoit la clause `SameShape` : la destination a la forme de la source (isomorphisme d'arbres, enfants appariés dans l'ordre des indices, (c) 1).
   - La correspondance des parties est `corr`. L'effet déplace chaque autorité détenue par une partie de la source, et chaque emplacement qu'elle possède, vers la partie correspondante de la destination (`mvTo`, `transfer_to_corresponding_parts`). La racine suit l'emplacement possédé (`transfer_rootHeld`, inchangé).
   - L'invariant des états atteints `WF3 ∧ Inv3 ∧ AnchorOrderHeld ∧ NoOrphan ∧ ArenaInv` reste démontré (`reachable_access_invariant_ext`, texte inchangé).
2. **`issue`, `reset`, `newArena` (J1).** La destination d'un `issue` est une feuille non `Init` qui ne détient aucune autorité active, et elle seule passe à `Init`. `issue` et `reset` n'écrivent plus la valeur arène. `newArena` exige toutes les feuilles du détenteur de `internal` `Init` (`LeavesInit`).
3. **Initialisation par les seules écritures (J1).** `init_only_by_writes` : dans tout pas `ok`, une feuille qui passe à `Init` est écrite par ce pas (`write3`, `writeShared`, `store` ou `issue` vers elle), ou est la feuille de la destination d'un `transfer` qui correspond à une feuille `Init` de la source. `init_statics` : sur `S3.init`, seules les feuilles statiques déclarées `Init` le sont.
4. **Cas.** Les trois témoins de la passe 7 de feuilles rendues `Init` sans écriture sont rejetés ; chacun a son jumeau `ok` suivi d'une lecture `ok`. Les cas demandés (autorité stockée dans un champ, stockage possédé, transfert champ par champ) donnent les verdicts attendus ((g)).
5. **Deux questions nouvelles ((e)).**
   - L'isomorphisme ordonné rejette des transferts que l'isomorphisme non ordonné accepterait, et l'isomorphisme non ordonné ne fixe pas de correspondance unique.
   - J1 se contredit sur un `issue` vers une feuille non `Init` de la valeur arène : la puce 2 l'accepte et le rend `Init`, la puce 3 interdit de changer l'initialisation de la valeur arène.
6. **J2.** Rien n'est ajouté pour `NoLock`, la forme forte de F6 ni `noalias`. `ParamOriginHidden`, `EnterPre`, `StorePre`, `CoversHolder`, `Linked`, `NoOrphan` et `call_params_effective_protected` ont le texte de la passe 7.
7. **Bilan de clôture du jalon 1** en (q). Aucun contre-exemple de sûreté ouvert sur les propriétés démontrées.

## Commits

| Commit | Contenu |

| `ea5a8bc` | Étape 2 (J1) : cas |

Chaque commit se construit sans avertissement.

## Corrections après la revue adverse

Trois relecteurs, chacun avec une lecture : initialisation (tout autre chemin vers une feuille `Init` jamais écrite), forme (tout transfert légal rejeté à tort par `SameShape`), intégrité (énoncés, témoins, couverture des cas). Dix constats, chacun soumis à un juge chargé de le réfuter, qui a recompilé le témoin. Sept sont confirmés, trois réfutés.

| # | Lecture | Gravité | Constat | Suite |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | forme | majeur (spécification) | `SameShape` lit « sous-arbres isomorphes » comme un isomorphisme ordonné, ce que J1 ne dit pas ; un transfert entre arbres isomorphes à l'ordre des enfants près est rejeté par cette seule clause | témoin `transfer_shape_ordered` ; question (e) 1 |
| 2 | initialisation | majeur (spécification) | un `issue` vers une feuille `Moved` de la valeur arène l'accepte et la rend `Init` : J1, puces 2 et 3, ne peuvent tenir ensemble ; la docstring de `issueEff` disait le contraire | témoin `issue_into_arena_value` ; docstring de `issueEff` corrigée ; question (e) 2 |
| 3 | intégrité | majeur | `transfer_not_inv3_preserving` avait été réénoncé en rejet, au motif qu'aucune destination n'aurait la forme de la source ; c'est faux : une destination qui copie le lien parent ignoré par `chain` a cette forme, et le transfert, accepté, casse `Inv3` | énoncé de la passe 7 rétabli mot pour mot sur un témoin de même forme ; le témoin de la passe 7 gardé (`transfer_not_inv3_preserving_p7_rejected`) |
| 4 | intégrité | mineur | `mvTo_part`, `transfer_usable_fwd` et `transfer_dst_not_owned` supposaient `SameShape` (et une borne de longueur) sans s'en servir | hypothèses retirées ; seule `WF3 s` reste, justifiée en (i) |
| 5 | intégrité | mineur | les cas d'arène imbriquée de la passe 7 (émissions par l'arène fille, `reset` du parent avant et après la libération de son `internal`) avaient disparu sans être listés | cas `child_arena_in_block` ; retraits listés en (p) |
| 6 | initialisation | mineur | le jumeau de `issue_inits_unwritten` n'avait pas de lecture `ok` | `Read3Step 2 [3] it3 (.ok it3)` ajouté |
| 7 | intégrité | mineur | la docstring de `transfer_no_duplicate_authority` disait que les autorités passent à la destination | corrigée : à la partie correspondante (J1) |
| 8 | forme | réfuté | `SameShape` ne compare pas `kind` | `kind` n'est interprété par aucune règle depuis la passe 1 ; le comparer inventerait une sémantique ; (c) 3 |
| 9 | initialisation | réfuté | `init_statics` porte sur tout indice, non seulement sur les feuilles | plus fort que J1 sur une valeur qu'aucune règle ne lit ; (c) 10 |
| 10 | intégrité | réfuté | `transfer_preserves_noDangling` et `transfer_frameOf_back` changent sans docstring qui cite J1 | la justification est en (i) ; `transfer_frameOf_back` est un lemme technique sans règle propre |

Points vérifiés sans constat : `init_only_by_writes` couvre les dix-neuf relations de pas de `Reachable` ; le relecteur de l'initialisation n'a pas trouvé d'autre chemin vers une feuille `Init` jamais écrite (dans `issue_into_arena_value`, la feuille est écrite par l'`issue`, au sens de J1) ; les transferts de même forme ordonnée essayés par le relecteur de la forme, y compris entre structures à indices entrelacés, sont acceptés.

## (i) Énoncés de la passe 7 retirés ou réécrits

Comparaison mécanique des énoncés entre `d01fc23` et la fin de la passe 8 (hypothèses et conclusion jusqu'au `:=` de niveau zéro) : 580 théorèmes en passe 7, 605 en passe 8 ; 565 au texte inchangé ; 14 réécrits ; 1 retiré.

L'état `nA4` n'est plus atteint par ce pas. Les définitions `nA4`, `nA5` et les `example` qui les lisent sont retirés avec lui ((p)). |

## (j) Transfert, fin d'usage et allocation des valeurs composites

La description de la passe 7 ((j)) vaut, avec ces changements.

- **`transfer src dst`** (J1). `dst` a la forme de `src` ; toutes les feuilles de `src` sont `Init` ; aucune feuille de `dst` ne l'est.
  - Effet : les feuilles de `dst` passent à `Init`, celles de `src` à `Moved`.
  - Une autorité détenue par une partie `r` de `src` passe à `corr r` (`transfer_field_authority_follows`).
  - Un emplacement possédé par `r` passe à `corr r` et garde son parent. Sa racine, détenue par `r` (`RootHeld`), suit (`transfer_owned_storage_follows`).
- **Agrégat partiellement initialisé** : il se transfère champ par champ (`transfer_field_by_field`). Ce que détient ou possède le conteneur lui-même ne suit que son propre transfert ((e) 1).
- **`issue`** vers une feuille non `Init` qui ne détient aucune autorité active ; elle seule passe à `Init`. Une structure entière (`issue_inits_unwritten`) et la valeur arène, qui détient `internal` (`x_issue_to_value_rejected`), sont refusées. Une feuille non `Init` de la valeur arène est acceptée (question (e) 2).
- **`newArena`** exige la valeur arène entièrement `Init` ; **`issue`** et **`reset`** ne l'écrivent plus.

`Reachable k statics` est la clôture de `S3.init statics`, pour un stockage statique valide, par les dix-neuf opérations de la passe 7 ((n) 1). Changent : `transfer` (J1, forme et parties correspondantes), `issue` (J1, feuille libre), `reset` (J1, sans écriture de `I`), `newArena` (J1, valeur arène `Init`). **Invariants des états atteints** (`reachable_access_invariant_ext`, texte de la passe 7) : `WF3 s ∧ Inv3 s ∧ AnchorOrderHeld s ∧ NoOrphan s ∧ ∀ ar ∈ s.arenas, s.Active ar.internal → ArenaInv s ar`.

Tous valent sous l'effet de J1. Pour `issue`, `reset` et `newArena` : `issueAt_preserves`, `resetAt_preserves`, `newArena_preserves`.

**Conséquences démontrées.**
- Celles de la passe 7, (n) 1, sur le nouveau domaine, sauf `nested_reachable`, retiré ((i)).

/-- J1, « sous-arbres isomorphes », read as an ordered isomorphism (`SameShape`: children matched
in index order); a question of the pass-8 report. Frame 1: structure 0 with the leaf 1 and the
structure 2 of fields 3 and 4; structure 5 with the structure 6 of fields 7 and 8, then the leaf 9;
structure 10 with the leaf 11 and the structure 12 of fields 13 and 14. The frame writes the leaves
of 0. The transfer of 0 into 5, isomorphic as unordered trees only, is rejected, by the shape

structure 0 with the fields 1 and 2, the arena value; 3 the allocator value; 4 a leaf. `alloc` gives
the storage 5 with the part 6, owned by 0. The frame writes 1 and 2, registers the arena
(`newArena 5 3`), moves the field 1 into 4 (1 becomes `Moved`), then issues `[6]` to 1: accepted,
1 is `Init` again. -/
def iv0 : S3 := enter1 [(none, none, 0), (some 0, none, 0), (some 0, none, 0), (none, none, 0),
  (none, none, 0)]
def iv1 : S3 := allocEff (write3Eff iv0 [3]) 3 0 [(none, none, 0), (some 5, none, 0)]
def iv1w : S3 := write3Eff iv1 [1, 2]
def iv2 : S3 := newArenaEff iv1w 5 3
def arIv : Arena := ⟨5, 3, [6], []⟩
def iv3 : S3 := transferEff iv2 1 4
def iv4 : S3 := arenaSet (issueEff iv3 arIv [6] 1).1 0 (issueEff iv3 arIv [6] 1).2

    Reachable K0 [] iv4 ∧ arenaValue iv3 arIv = some 0 ∧ 1 ∈ footprint iv3.P 0 ∧
      iv2.I 1 = .init ∧ iv3.I 1 = .moved ∧ IssueAt K0 0 0 [6] 1 iv3 (.ok iv4) ∧ iv4.I 1 = .init := by

  have r1 : Reachable K0 [] iv1 := .alloc (.write r0 (show Write3Step 1 [3] iv0 (.ok _) from
    .ok (by decide))) (show AllocStep K0 3 0 [(none, none, 0), (some 5, none, 0)] _ (.ok iv1) from
      .ok (by decide) trivial)
  have r2 : Reachable K0 [] iv2 := .newArena (.write r1 (show Write3Step 0 [1, 2] iv1 (.ok iv1w) from

def HolderRight (s : S3) : Holder → Prop
  | .frame f => f = s.top
  | .place p => HasRight s .modify p

instance (s : S3) (h : Holder) : Decidable (HolderRight s h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold HolderRight <;> infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `release` (MM-03.3 §3, O3), in order: 1 active authority; 2 no active
descendant; 3 no usable place has `a` as anchor, except the place that holds `a`, whose anchor
`a` is removed by the release (F4); C4: the authority is derived, an authority
without origin is rejected, and its holder is the current frame or a place on which the current
frame has exercisable `Modify` (`HolderRight`). O3.4 (guarantees of associated abstractions) is
not represented in the kernel. -/
def ReleasePre (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Prop :=
  s.Active a ∧
  (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ s.Active j) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → a ∈ s.D q → (s.A[a]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place q)) ∧
  OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.origin ≠ none ∧ HolderRight s y.holder) False

instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Decidable (ReleasePre s a) := by unfold ReleasePre; infer_instance

/-- `release` as a relation (MM-03.3 §3, O3). -/
def ReleaseStep (a : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (ReleasePre s a) (releaseEff s a)

/-! ## O4 `transfer` (MM-03.3 §3, A4, A5) -/

/-! ## Shape of a value (J1) -/

/-- Children of the place `x` (MM-03.3.2), in index order. -/
def kids (P : List Place) (x : Nat) : List Nat :=
  (List.range P.length).filter fun r => decide (parentOf P r = some x)

/-- Position of `r` in a list (its length if absent). -/
def posIn (r : Nat) : List Nat → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | a :: l => if a = r then 0 else posIn r l + 1

/-- The part of `dst` that corresponds to the part `r` of `src` (J1), searched within `n` steps:
`dst` for `src`; for another part, the child, at the same position among the children ordered by
index, of the place that corresponds to its parent. -/
def corrF (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Nat → Nat → Option Nat
  | 0, r => if r = src then some dst else none
  | n + 1, r => if r = src then some dst else
      match parentOf P r with
      | some p => if p < r then
          (corrF P src dst n p).bind fun p' => (kids P p')[posIn r (kids P p)]? else none
      | none => none

/-- The part of `dst` that corresponds to the part `r` of `src` (J1). -/
def corr (P : List Place) (src dst r : Nat) : Option Nat := corrF P src dst r r

/-- J1, « `dst` a la même forme que `src` (sous-arbres isomorphes) »: every part of `src` has a
corresponding part of `dst` with as many children, and every part of `dst` corresponds to a part
of `src`. Children are matched in index order (ordered isomorphism). -/
def SameShape (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  (∀ r ∈ List.range P.length, partOf P r src →
    OptP (corr P src dst r) (fun r' => (kids P r').length = (kids P r).length) False) ∧
  ∀ z ∈ List.range P.length, partOf P z dst →
    ∃ r ∈ List.range P.length, partOf P r src ∧ corr P src dst r = some z

instance (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Decidable (SameShape P src dst) := by
  unfold SameShape; infer_instance

/-- Holder within the value at `q` (A4): a place that is `q` or one of its parts. -/
def heldIn (P : List Place) (q : Nat) : Holder → Prop
  | .place r => partOf P r q
  | .frame _ => False

instance (P : List Place) (q : Nat) (h : Holder) : Decidable (heldIn P q h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold heldIn <;> infer_instance

/-- The holder `h` after the transfer of `src` to `dst` (J1): a place, part of `src`, becomes the
corresponding part of `dst` (`corr`, `dst` itself for `src`). Applied to the holders within the
value only. -/
def mvTo (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Holder → Holder
  | .place r => .place ((corr P src dst r).getD dst)
  | .frame f => .frame f

/-- Effect of `transfer(source, destination)` (MM-03.3 §3, O4; A4; A5; J1): every leaf of the
destination becomes `Init`, every leaf of the source `Moved`; the anchors of the source, inherited
ones included, join those of the destination and leave the source and its parts; every authority
held by a part of the source (the source included) is now held by the corresponding part of the
destination (A4, J1); every place owned by a part of the source is now owned by the corresponding
part of the destination, without moving, and its root follows (A5, J1, `RootHeld`). -/
def transferEff (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with
    P := s.P.map fun pl =>
      if heldIn s.P src pl.owner then { pl with owner := mvTo s.P src dst pl.owner } else pl
    I := fun l => if l ∈ footprint s.P dst then .init
      else if l ∈ footprint s.P src then .moved else s.I l
    D := fun q => if q = dst then s.D dst ++ depsOf s src
      else if partOf s.P q src then [] else s.D q
    A := s.A.map fun y =>
      if heldIn s.P src y.holder then { y with holder := mvTo s.P src dst y.holder } else y }

/-- Active derived access covering a leaf of the source and not moved with it
(MM-03.3 §3, O4.4; A4). -/
def ActiveDerivedOutside (s : S3) (src j : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧ ¬ heldIn s.P src y.holder ∧
    ∃ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∈ footprint s.P src) False

instance (s : S3) (src j : Nat) : Decidable (ActiveDerivedOutside s src j) := by
  unfold ActiveDerivedOutside; infer_instance

      EffAnchorOK (transferEff s src dst) x ((transferEff s src dst).pframe q)) ∧
  AnchorOrderHeld (transferEff s src dst) ∧ SameShape s.P src dst

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) :
    Decidable (TransferPre k s src dst) := by
  unfold TransferPre; infer_instance

/-- `transfer` as a relation (MM-03.3 §3, O4). -/
def TransferStep (k : K) (src dst : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (TransferPre k s src dst) (transferEff s src dst)

/-! ## O5 `depend` (MM-03.3 §3) -/

/-- Effect of `depend(result, anchor)` (MM-03.3 §3, O5): the anchor joins the dependencies of
the result place; existing dependencies are kept; propagation to containing values is computed
by `depsOf`. -/
def dependEff (s : S3) (q x : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with D := fun r => if r = q then s.D q ++ [x] else s.D r }

/-- Preconditions of `depend` (MM-03.3 §3, O5), in order: result place usable (MM-03.3.1);
1 valid anchor; 5 non-escape (MM-03.3.6); B3: exercisable `Modify` on the result; C1: the frame
of the effective anchor is the frame of the result or an ancestor of it (`EffAnchorOK`). O5.2
(real origin of the rights or storage) is not representable: the state does not relate a value
to the origin of its content. O5.3 and O5.4 hold by construction. -/
def DependPre (s : S3) (q x : Nat) : Prop :=
  s.Usable q ∧ s.Active x ∧ NoEscape s x (s.pframe q) ∧ HasRight s .modify q ∧
    EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)

instance (s : S3) (q x : Nat) : Decidable (DependPre s q x) := by
  unfold DependPre; infer_instance

/-- `depend` as a relation (MM-03.3 §3, O5). -/
def DependStep (q x : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (DependPre s q x) (dependEff s q x)

/-! ## F4 `store` -/

/-- Effect of `store a p` (F4; G2), the write of a reference into a value: `a` is now held by the
place `p`; `a` joins the anchors of `p`; the leaf `p`, and it only, becomes `Init` (G2). -/
def storeEff (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : S3 := match s.A[a]? with
  | some y => { s with
      A := s.A.set a { y with holder := .place p }
      D := fun q => if q = p then s.D p ++ [a] else s.D q
      I := fun l => if l = p then .init else s.I l }
  | none => s

def issueEff (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : S3 × Arena :=
  ({ s.addAuth ⟨.modify, some ar.internal, region, .place dst, true⟩ with
      I := fun l => if l = dst then .init else s.I l },
   { ar with

      issued := (region, s.A.length) :: ar.issued })

/-- Static preconditions of `arena.issue(region)` (MM-03.3 §6; A10): metadata right (A10); the
region lies in the storage administered by `internal`; the destination `dst` of the block is
usable, exercisable in `Modify` (A2) and holds no initialised value; J1: `dst` is a leaf

def IssueStatic (k : K) (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) :
    Prop :=

  s.Usable dst ∧ HasRight s .modify dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init) ∧
  isLeaf s.P dst ∧
  ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place dst)

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat)

/-- The region is available (MM-03.3 §6): otherwise `issue` fails (A10). -/

instance (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) : Decidable (Avail ar region) := by
  unfold Avail; infer_instance

/-- The abstraction has, through `internal`, effective `Modify` on the region (MM-03.3 §6:
the abstraction has the authority needed to distribute the region). The
disjointness from active emissions is removed (A11): it follows from this right
(`issue_disjoint_redundant`). -/
def IssueRight (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ l ∈ region, effective s ar.internal l = some .modify

instance (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) : Decidable (IssueRight s ar region) := by

(pass-1 arbitrage 6). -/

  | fail (s : S3) (ar : Arena)

`fail`, with the state unchanged, when the region is unavailable; `reject` when the region is
....

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) :
    Decidable (ResetPre k s ar via) := by

/-- Effect of `arena.reset()` (MM-03.3 §6; A10; J1): the whole storage becomes available, the past
emissions are forgotten; the initialisation of the arena value is unchanged (J1). -/
def resetEff (s : S3) (ar : Arena) : S3 × Arena :=
  (s, { ar with available := s.afp ar.internal, issued := [] })

/-- `arena.reset` as a relation (MM-03.3 §6; A10). -/
def ResetStep (k : K) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 (S3 × Arena) → Prop :=
  Guarded (ResetPre k s ar via) (resetEff s ar)

theorem afp_addAuth_lt {s : S3} {y₀ : Authority} {j : Nat} (h : j < s.A.length) :
    (s.addAuth y₀).afp j = s.afp j := by simp only [S3.afp, addAuth_lt h]

theorem active_addAuth_iff {s : S3} {y₀ : Authority} {x : Nat} (hx : x < s.A.length) :
    (s.addAuth y₀).Active x ↔ s.Active x := by
  simp only [S3.Active, addAuth_lt hx]

/-- The disjointness of a new emission from the active ones follows from the authority of
`internal` (MM-03.3 §6; A11): an active block derived from `internal` covering a leaf takes the
....

/-! ## Arenas in the state (D3) -/

/-- The state with the entry `i` of `arenas` replaced by `ar` (D3). -/
def arenaSet (s : S3) (i : Nat) (ar : Arena) : S3 := { s with arenas := s.arenas.set i ar }

/-- J1: the leaves of the holder `h`, if it is a place, are all `Init`. -/
def LeavesInit (s : S3) : Holder → Prop
  | .place v => ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P v, s.I l = .init
  | .frame _ => True

instance (s : S3) (h : Holder) : Decidable (LeavesInit s h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold LeavesInit <;> infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `newArena storage internal` (D3, F1, F2, J1), in order. Kept from D3: exercisable
`Modify` on `storage`; `storage` usable. F1: `internal`, named by the caller, is active, `Modify`,
exercisable at `Modify` (B2), and held by a place, the arena value; the footprint of `internal` is
the footprint of `storage`; no live arena already has `internal` as `internal`. F1 removes the
guard by place index of D3 and the kind of `internal`; F2 removes the ownership of the storage
(A10): the storage may be a local, a static, an allocated root or a block. J1: the leaves of the
arena value, the holder of `internal`, are all `Init` (`LeavesInit`). -/
def NewArenaPre (s : S3) (storage internal : Nat) : Prop :=
  HasRight s .modify storage ∧ s.Usable storage ∧
    OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.mode = .modify ∧ y.holder.isPlace = true)
      False ∧
    s.ExercisableAt internal .modify ∧
    (∀ l ∈ s.afp internal, l ∈ footprint s.P storage) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P storage, l ∈ s.afp internal) ∧
    (∀ ar ∈ s.arenas, s.Active ar.internal → ar.internal ≠ internal) ∧
    OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => LeavesInit s y.holder) True

instance (s : S3) (storage internal : Nat) : Decidable (NewArenaPre s storage internal) := by
  unfold NewArenaPre; infer_instance

/-- Effect of `newArena storage internal` (D3; F1): a new entry, the whole storage available,
nothing issued. -/
def newArenaEff (s : S3) (storage internal : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with arenas := s.arenas ++ [⟨storage, internal, s.afp internal, []⟩] }

/-- `newArena storage internal : ok | reject` as a relation (D3; F1). -/
def NewArenaStep (storage internal : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (NewArenaPre s storage internal) (newArenaEff s storage internal)

/-- `arena.issue` on the entry `i` of the state (MM-03.3 §6; A10; D3): the step `IssueStep` of the
recorded arena, whose new logical state is written back; a missing entry is rejected. An entry
whose `internal` is released is rejected by `IssueStatic`, which asks it active. -/
inductive IssueAt (k : K) (i via : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) (s : S3) :
    AOutcome → Prop where
  | ok {ar : Arena} {s' : S3} {ar' : Arena} : s.arenas[i]? = some ar →
      IssueStep k ar via region dst s (.ok s' ar') → IssueAt k i via region dst s (.ok (arenaSet s' i ar'))
  | fail {ar : Arena} {s' : S3} {ar' : Arena} : s.arenas[i]? = some ar →
      IssueStep k ar via region dst s (.fail s' ar') → IssueAt k i via region dst s (.fail s)
  | reject {ar : Arena} : s.arenas[i]? = some ar → IssueStep k ar via region dst s .reject →
      IssueAt k i via region dst s .reject
  | none : s.arenas[i]? = none → IssueAt k i via region dst s .reject

/-- Preconditions of `arena.reset()` on the entry `i` of the state (MM-03.3 §6; A10; D3): the entry
exists and is live (an entry whose `internal` is released cannot be reset), and `ResetPre`. -/
def ResetAtPre (k : K) (s : S3) (i via : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.arenas[i]?) (fun ar => s.Active ar.internal ∧ ResetPre k s ar via) False

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (i via : Nat) :
    Decidable (ResetAtPre k s i via) := by
  unfold ResetAtPre; infer_instance

/-- Effect of `arena.reset()` on the entry `i` (D3): `resetEff`, the new logical state written
back. -/
def resetAtEff (s : S3) (i : Nat) : S3 :=
  match s.arenas[i]? with
  | some ar => arenaSet (resetEff s ar).1 i (resetEff s ar).2
  | none => s

/-- `arena.reset` on the entry `i` of the state as a relation (D3). -/
def ResetAtStep (k : K) (i via : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (ResetAtPre k s i via) (resetAtEff s i)

/-- Determinism of `newArena` (D3; F1). -/
theorem newArena_det {st i : Nat} {s : S3} {o₁ o₂ : Outcome3 S3} (h₁ : NewArenaStep st i s o₁)
    (h₂ : NewArenaStep st i s o₂) : o₁ = o₂ := Guarded.det h₁ h₂

/-- Determinism of `arena.reset` on an entry of the state (D3). -/
theorem resetAt_det {k : K} {i via : Nat} {s : S3} {o₁ o₂ : Outcome3 S3}
    (h₁ : ResetAtStep k i via s o₁) (h₂ : ResetAtStep k i via s o₂) : o₁ = o₂ := Guarded.det h₁ h₂

/-- Determinism of `arena.issue` on an entry of the state (MM-03.3 §6; A10; D3). -/
theorem issueAt_det {k : K} {i via dst : Nat} {region : List Nat} {s : S3} {o₁ o₂ : AOutcome}
    (h₁ : IssueAt k i via region dst s o₁) (h₂ : IssueAt k i via region dst s o₂) : o₁ = o₂ := by
  have key : ∀ {ar ar' : Arena} {o o' : IOutcome}, s.arenas[i]? = some ar →
      s.arenas[i]? = some ar' → IssueStep k ar via region dst s o →
      IssueStep k ar' via region dst s o' → o = o' := by
    intro ar ar' o o' h h' hs hs'; rw [h] at h'; cases h'; exact issue_det hs hs'

/-! ## Reachability (MM-03.3 §10) -/

/-- States reached from the initial state with the static storage `statics` (D1) by `ok`
transitions of the kernel operations, of the arena operations `newArena`, `issue` and `reset`
(D3), and of `store` (F4), for fixed contracts `k` (MM-03.3.8). The static storage is well-formed (`ShapeOK`, C6). -/
inductive Reachable (k : K) (statics : Statics) : S3 → Prop where
  | init : ShapeOK 0 (statics.map (·.1)) → Reachable k statics (S3.init statics)
  | derive {s s' : S3} {src q : Nat} {m : Mode} :
      Reachable k statics s → DeriveStep src q m s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | split {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {rs : List (List Nat)} :
      Reachable k statics s → SplitStep k src rs s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | release {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} : Reachable k statics s → ReleaseStep a s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | transfer {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} :

  | depend {s s' : S3} {q x : Nat} : Reachable k statics s → DependStep q x s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | enter {s s' : S3} {ps : List Nat} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)} :
      Reachable k statics s → EnterStep ps ls s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | exit {s s' : S3} : Reachable k statics s → ExitStep k s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | read {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} :
      Reachable k statics s → Read3Step a ls s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | write {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} :
      Reachable k statics s → Write3Step a ls s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | writeShared {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} :
      Reachable k statics s → WriteSharedStep k a ls s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | pin {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : Reachable k statics s → PinStep p s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | unpin {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : Reachable k statics s → UnpinStep k p s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | endUse {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : Reachable k statics s → EndUseStep k p s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | free {s s' : S3} {p auth : Nat} :
      Reachable k statics s → FreeStep k p auth s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | alloc {s s' : S3} {pr ow : Nat} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)} :
      Reachable k statics s → AllocStep k pr ow ls s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | newArena {s s' : S3} {st i : Nat} :
      Reachable k statics s → NewArenaStep st i s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | issue {s s' : S3} {i via dst : Nat} {region : List Nat} :
      Reachable k statics s → IssueAt k i via region dst s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | reset {s s' : S3} {i via : Nat} :
      Reachable k statics s → ResetAtStep k i via s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | store {s s' : S3} {a p : Nat} :
      Reachable k statics s → StoreStep a p s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'

/-- Invariants of the reached states (MM-03.3 §10; B8, C1, C2, D3): `WF3`, `Inv3`, arena entries
naming existing authorities (`ArenasWF`) and `ArenaInv` for every live arena. Under `DDSound k`
(MM-03.3.8), used by `split`. -/
theorem reachable_invariants {k : K} (hdd : DDSound k) {statics : Statics} {s : S3}
    (h : Reachable k statics s) : WF3 s ∧ Inv3 s ∧ ArenasWF s ∧ ArenasInv s := by
  have mk : ∀ {s s' : S3}, KStep k s s' → WF3 s ∧ Inv3 s ∧ ArenasWF s ∧ ArenasInv s →
      WF3 s' ∧ Inv3base s' → AnchorOrder s' → NoDangling s' →
      WF3 s' ∧ Inv3 s' ∧ ArenasWF s' ∧ ArenasInv s' :=
    fun hk ih h a d => ⟨h.1, ⟨h.2, a, d⟩,
      kstep_preserves_arenas ih.1 ih.2.1.base ih.2.2.1 ih.2.2.2 hk⟩
  induction h with
  | init hsh =>
    exact ⟨(init_wf statics hsh).1, (init_wf statics hsh).2, fun _ h => by simp [S3.init] at h,
      fun _ h => by simp [S3.init] at h⟩
  | derive _ hs ih =>
    exact mk (.derive hs) ih (derive_preserves ih.1 ih.2.1.base hs)
      (derive_preserves_anchorOrder ih.2.1.ao hs) (derive_preserves_noDangling ih.2.1.nd hs)
  | split _ hs ih =>
    exact mk (.split hs) ih (split_preserves_underDD hdd ih.1 ih.2.1.base hs)
      (split_preserves_anchorOrder ih.2.1.ao hs) (split_preserves_noDangling ih.2.1.nd hs)

/-! ## Initialisation only by writes (J1) -/

/-- One step of `Reachable` (MM-03.3 §10; D3; F4): a kernel step or an arena step. -/
inductive Step (k : K) : S3 → S3 → Prop where
  | kernel {s s' : S3} : KStep k s s' → Step k s s'
  | newArena {s s' : S3} {st i : Nat} : NewArenaStep st i s (.ok s') → Step k s s'
  | issue {s s' : S3} {i via dst : Nat} {region : List Nat} :
      IssueAt k i via region dst s (.ok s') → Step k s s'
  | reset {s s' : S3} {i via : Nat} : ResetAtStep k i via s (.ok s') → Step k s s'

/-- J1: the step from `s` to `s'` writes the leaf `l`: a `write3` or a `writeShared` of a list
containing `l`, a `store` into `l`, an `issue` to `l`, or a `transfer` of which `l` is a leaf of the
destination corresponding to a leaf of the source `Init` before the step. -/
def WrittenBy (k : K) (s s' : S3) (l : Nat) : Prop :=
  (∃ a ls, Write3Step a ls s (.ok s') ∧ l ∈ ls) ∨
  (∃ a ls, WriteSharedStep k a ls s (.ok s') ∧ l ∈ ls) ∨
  (∃ a, StoreStep a l s (.ok s')) ∨
  (∃ i via region, IssueAt k i via region l s (.ok s')) ∨
  (∃ src dst l', TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s') ∧ l ∈ footprint s.P dst ∧
    l' ∈ footprint s.P src ∧ corr s.P src dst l' = some l ∧ s.I l' = .init)

/-- `init_only_by_writes` (J1): in every `ok` step, a leaf that is not `Init` before and is
`Init` after is written by the step (`WrittenBy`). -/
theorem init_only_by_writes {k : K} {s s' : S3} (h : Step k s s') {l : Nat}
    (hl : s.I l ≠ .init) (hl' : s'.I l = .init) : WrittenBy k s s' l := by
  cases h with
  | kernel hk =>
    cases hk with
    | derive hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact absurd hl' hl
    | split hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact absurd hl' hl
    | release hs =>
      rename_i a
      obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
      unfold releaseEff at hl'; split at hl' <;> exact absurd hl' hl
    | transfer hs =>
      rename_i src dst
      have hs' := hs
      obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
      simp only [transferEff] at hl'
      split at hl'
  | reset hs =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
    unfold resetAtEff at hl'; split at hl' <;> exact absurd hl' hl

/-- `init_statics` (J1; D1): in the initial state, a leaf is `Init` exactly when it is a static
element declared `Init`. -/
theorem init_statics (statics : Statics) (l : Nat) :
    (S3.init statics).I l = .init ↔ ∃ e, statics[l]? = some e ∧ e.2 = true := by
  simp only [S3.init]
  cases h : statics[l]? with
  | none => simp
  | some e => cases he : e.2 <;> simp [he]

/-- `exitFrame_no_dangling` on reached states (MM-03.3 §4, O7; §10), under `DDSound k`
(MM-03.3.8). -/
theorem exitFrame_no_dangling_reachable {k : K} (hdd : DDSound k) {statics : Statics} {s s' : S3} {f : Nat}
    {F₀ : Frames} (hs : Reachable k statics s) (hF : s.F = f :: F₀) (h : ExitStep k s (.ok s')) :
    ∀ q, OwnedByFrame s.P f q → ∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), s'.A[j]? = some y →
      y.active = true → ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∉ y.footprint :=
  exitFrame_no_dangling (reachable_access_invariant_underDD hdd hs).1 hF h

## (q) Statut de `NoOrphan` et de `call_protects_params_safe`

### `NoOrphan` (G3) : démontré

`reachable_no_orphan` : sur tout état atteint, sous `DDSound k`, toute autorité active détenue par un emplacement est reliée à un cadre de la pile par une chaîne de détenteurs sans répétition, chaque maillon actif couvrant toutes les feuilles de l'emplacement qui détient le maillon suivant. `NoOrphan` est dans l'invariant des états atteints (`reachable_access_invariant_ext`).

**Preuve.** Par l'invariant auxiliaire `RootLive`, préservé par chaque opération ((c) 8). La chaîne d'une autorité détenue par `q` est faite des racines des emplacements de la chaîne des propriétaires de `q`, du cadre jusqu'à `q` ; chacune couvre l'emplacement suivant, qui en est une partie ou possède la racine. Aucune opération, `store` ou autre, ne construit d'orphelin au sens de G3.

**Ce que `NoOrphan` ne dit pas.** Une racine couvre son emplacement même quand elle n'y a plus de mode effectif. `NoOrphan` tient donc pour des raisons de structure, sans dire qu'une autorité détenue soit exerçable. Il tient dans chacun des états atteints suivants, où des autorités détenues ne sont exerçables par aucun cadre ((j)) :
- `held_unexercisable_by_transfer` : une autorité détenue par l'emplacement qu'elle couvre, après un `transfer` ;
- `held_unexercisable_by_issue` : un bloc émis vers une partie de sa propre région ;
- `f7a_cycle_by_release`, `three_node_cycle_by_release`, `cycle_by_exit`, `cycle_by_free` : des cycles d'autorités stockées, chacune exerçable seulement par la précédente, refermés après les `store`.

Dans chacun de ces états, la pile est `[1, 0]`, le cadre courant n'exerce les autorités en cause à aucun mode, et le cadre de base n'en détient aucune (`NothingAtFrame0`) : aucun cadre de la pile ne les exerce.

**Autre lecture.** Lu avec la couverture effective (chaque maillon a un mode effectif sur toutes les feuilles de l'emplacement suivant, `NoOrphanEff`), G3 serait faux sur les états atteints `hu1` et `iu1` (`noOrphanEff_fails`). La lecture « un maillon exerçable » n'a pas été étudiée. Question (e) 2.

### `call_protects_params_safe` (F6, gardé par G1) : faux

`call_protects_params_safe_false` : ni la forme transitive (`CallProtects`) ni la forme directe (`CallProtectsDirect`) ne tiennent sur tous les états atteints. La preuve inductive demandée par G1 est donc impossible. Les témoins, tous acceptés par G1, relèvent de trois mécanismes :

1. **Un ancêtre plus lointain que l'origine directe**, que G1 ne contraint pas :
   - `call_protects_params_safe_fails_grand` : l'appelant dérive 1 de sa racine, 2 de 1, 3 de 2 (`Modify` sur la feuille 0), et passe `[1, 3]`. L'origine directe de 3 est 2, détenue par l'appelant : G1 accepte. Dans l'appelé, 1 est exerçable, couvre la feuille 0 de 3 et en est un ancêtre. L'échec porte sur l'énoncé seul : 1 n'a pas de mode effectif sur 0 tant que 2 est active, même après `release 3`.
   - `call_arena_observe_block_param` : une arène passée en `Observe` rend `internal` exerçable en `Observe`, ancêtre du paramètre `Modify` dérivé d'un bloc ; échec sur l'énoncé seul.
2. **L'origine directe découverte pendant l'invocation** (`call_protects_params_safe_fails_unblock`, `_unblock_active`, cas `ub0`…`ub14`). L'origine 4 du paramètre 5 est détenue par une structure `q` de l'appelant. À l'entrée, elle n'est exerçable à aucun mode : le paramètre 6, `Modify` sur `q`, n'y a pas de mode effectif, ses descendants 7 et 8 couvrant chacun un champ de `q` ; 7 et 8 sont détenus par les champs d'une structure `w` sur laquelle le paramètre 9 donne `Modify`. `CallProtects` tient à l'entrée. L'appelé libère 7 et 8 (C4) : 6 retrouve `Modify` effectif sur `q`, et 4 est exerçable, que 5 soit encore actif ou déjà libéré. Après `release 5`, l'appelé écrit la feuille 0 par 4. C'est le dommage que F6 voulait exclure.
3. **Le ré-ancrage de la sortie** (O7, A7 ; `call_protects_params_safe_fails_exit`, `_exit_strict`). Un cadre repasse son paramètre 1 à un appelé, qui en dérive une autorité, la stocke dans une valeur de son appelant et sort. La sortie libère ce qui meurt avec l'appelé et rattache l'autorité stockée à la racine du premier appelant. De retour dans le cadre 2, elle est exerçable, couvre la feuille du paramètre 1 et n'en descend plus, bien qu'elle en soit issue ; le cadre 2 écrit par elle. La variante `_exit_strict` respecte la lecture stricte d'A3 (chaque paramètre dérivé par son appelant). Ni G1 ni la lecture stricte d'A3 n'empêchent ce cas ; la violation n'apparaît qu'à la sortie.

**Ce qui tient.**
- `call_params_effective_protected` (conservé) : tant qu'un paramètre `Modify` est actif, toute autorité de mode effectif présent sur ses feuilles est lui ou un de ses descendants.
- `enter_params_protected` : à l'entrée, la clause G1 et cette exclusivité.
- `release_keeps_origin_hidden` : la libération d'un paramètre `Modify`, à elle seule, ne rend jamais son origine directe exerçable. Le `release` ne change le mode effectif d'aucune autre autorité que le paramètre et son origine (`release_effective_other`), et l'exercice d'une autorité dans l'état d'arrivée se ramène à son exercice avant, sauf à passer par l'origine elle-même.

theorem transfer_moves_ownership {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat}
    (h : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) :
    ∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place), s.P[q]? = some pl →
      s'.P[q]? = some (if heldIn s.P src pl.owner then
        { pl with owner := mvTo s.P src dst pl.owner } else pl) := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact fun q pl hq => by rw [transfer_P_get, hq]; rfl

/-- J1: after an accepted transfer, an authority held by a part `r` of the source is held by the
corresponding part of the destination, which exists and is a part of `dst`; so is a place owned by
`r`, whose root, held by `r` (`RootHeld`), follows with it. -/
theorem transfer_to_corresponding_parts {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hwf : WF3 s)
    (h : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) {r : Nat} (hr : partOf s.P r src) :
    ∃ r', corr s.P src dst r = some r' ∧ partOf s.P r' dst ∧
      (∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[b]? = some y → y.holder = .place r →
        s'.A[b]? = some { y with holder := .place r' }) ∧
      (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .place r →
        s'.P[q]? = some { pl with owner := .place r' }) := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  have hsh := hpre.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2
  have h1 := hsh.1 r (List.mem_range.2 hr.1) hr
  unfold OptP at h1; split at h1
  · rename_i r' hc
    refine ⟨r', hc, corr_partOf hwf hpre.2.2.1.lt (r + 1) r r' (Nat.lt_succ_self r) hc,
      fun b y hy hh => ?_, fun q pl hq ho => ?_⟩
    · rw [transfer_A_get, hy]; simp [hh, heldIn, hr, mvTo, hc]

  obtain ⟨⟨hsrc, -, hdst, -, -, -, -, hd', -, h5, -, -, -, -, -⟩, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  have sk := transfer_skel s src dst

def NewArenaPre (s : S3) (storage internal : Nat) : Prop :=
  HasRight s .modify storage ∧ s.Usable storage ∧
    OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.mode = .modify ∧ y.holder.isPlace = true)
      False ∧
    s.ExercisableAt internal .modify ∧
    (∀ l ∈ s.afp internal, l ∈ footprint s.P storage) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P storage, l ∈ s.afp internal) ∧
    (∀ ar ∈ s.arenas, s.Active ar.internal → ar.internal ≠ internal)

instance (s : S3) (storage internal : Nat) : Decidable (NewArenaPre s storage internal) := by
def IssueStatic (k : K) (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) :
    Prop :=
  MetaRight k s ar via ∧ s.Active ar.internal ∧ (∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ s.afp ar.internal) ∧
  s.Usable dst ∧ HasRight s .modify dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init)

structure S3 where
  F : Frames
  nF : Nat
  P : List Place
  I : Nat → InitSt
  A : List Authority
  D : Nat → List Nat
  dead : Nat → Bool
  freed : Nat → Bool
  pin : Nat → Bool
  arenas : List Arena
  callParams : Nat → List Nat

/-- Contracts `K` (MM-03.3.8) for an execution. Types are a representation choice: regions as
lists of leaves; `SharedMutable`, `Pinned` and `ExternalDone` on leaves; `Deallocable p` and
`FreeCompat p auth` for `free` (A6); `Satisfiable provider shape s` for `alloc` (B5; C9: it
depends on the current state `s`, with the shape encoded as the locals of `enterFrame`, C6).
`Invalidates` is removed (B9). The obligations of each contract are named hypotheses of theorems, never
fields. -/
structure K where
  DeclaredDisjoint : List Nat → List Nat → Prop
141:inductive Holder where
144:deriving DecidableEq, Repr
150:structure Place where
154:deriving DecidableEq, Repr
201:inductive InitSt where
205:deriving DecidableEq, Repr
211:deriving DecidableEq, Repr
223:structure Authority where
229:deriving DecidableEq, Repr
241:deriving DecidableEq
1376:caller (A3, read since pass 2 without requiring the caller to be the deriving frame); the parent
8734:def enter1 (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : S3 := enterEff (S3.init []) [] ls

findings.claim: « `IssueAt K0 1 0 [4] 2 x5 (.ok …)` : retiré avec son état. La feuille 2 détient le bloc du parent, et la fille n'a plus de feuille libre non `Init`. »
findings.problem: Faux sur deux points, et un verdict changé manque au tableau. L'état `x5` n'est pas retiré : il est redéfini et toujours atteint. Sur lui, l'émission de l'arène fille vers 2 passe de `ok` (passe 7) à `reject` (passe 8), ce que le tableau des verdicts changés ne liste pas. Enfin, la fille a bien une feuille libre non `Init` : 4, vers laquelle l'émission est acceptée. Le cas pouvait donc être rejoué sur `x5`.
findings.evidence: Le module garde `def x5 : S3 := newArenaEff x4 4 4` (l. 10115), avec `x4` qui émet maintenant vers 2 (l. 10114), et garde aussi `example : ResetAtStep K0 0 0 x5 .reject` (l. 10128). Le fichier scratch /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guygouri-Devlab-ernlang-ern/c986905c-e900-4fd9-bebc-4a3ce7ebb180/scratchpad/p8ver/jk4.lean compile (rc=0). Il prouve `Reachable K0 [] x5`, `IssueAt K0 1 0 [4] 2 x5 .reject`, `IssueAt K0 1 0 [4] 4 x5 (.ok …)` et `isLeaf x5.P 4 ∧ x5.I 4 ≠ .init`.
findings.fix: Ajouter au tableau (p) la ligne `x5`, `issue [4]` de la fille vers 2 : `ok` → `reject`, avec sa cause (2 est `Init` et détient le bloc du parent). Retirer « retiré avec son état » et « la fille n'a plus de feuille libre non `Init` ». Dire que le cas reste rejouable sur `x5`, par exemple vers la feuille 4, et corriger (d) 1, qui range `x5` parmi les états qui ne sont plus atteints.

findings.claim: « énoncés qui supposent un pas `ok` de `transfer`, `issue` ou `newArena` | moins de pas, ceux que J1 rejette »
findings.problem: C'est faux pour `transfer`. Les clauses d'arrivée de `TransferPre` (`(transferEff s src dst).Usable dst`, B8, G4) sont évaluées sur le nouvel effet. Un transfert rejeté en passe 7 peut donc être accepté en passe 8. Les énoncés sans hypothèse `WF3` qui supposent un pas `transfer` `ok`, comme `transfer_no_duplicate_authority` et `transfer_moves_ownership`, couvrent ainsi des pas nouveaux. (p) dit d'ailleurs qu'« aucune preuve ne dit qu'elles ne deviennent jamais vraies là où elles étaient fausses ».
findings.evidence: Témoin `gx`, hors `WF3` : la partie 4 de `dst`=3 est possédée par le cadre 1 ; 3 est possédé par 2 ; 2 est possédé par la partie 1 de `src`=0.
